Voynich MS - Quire 11

General

For an explanation of the material found on this page, see here.

Description

Quire 11 contains one bifolio composing folios 71 and 72, the latter folding out to contain several panels with text and illustations. The gathering mark is on f72v1.

Schematic folio layout:

Folio 71

Normal folio. The folio nr. is on f71r.

f71r  

>>Link to 2014 scan (Beinecke digital library)

>>Link to 2004 scan (Jason Davies Voyager)

General description

This is a zodiac page. For general information about zodiac pages see here.
There is extraneous writing near the central zodiac emblem.
It has the folio nr. (71) in the upper right corner.

Illustration(s)

A circular diagram with the emblem of Aries consisting of a skinny sheep or goat eating from a bush. The animal has not been painted, but the bush is green.

There are two circular arrangements of tubs with small human figures (nymphs). There are 15 in total and each one is holding a star. They have all been painted in some detail.

Text

This page has 18 text items (loci), as follows:
3 items of circular writing;
15 zodiac labels.

There are three lines of circular text, one short, around the animal figure. There are 15 labels near the small human figures.

The month name April is written in the centre in a different hand than the remainder of the MS, and in a version of French (for which see here).

Currier language: -
RZ language: Ae- (page) / Ae- (folio) / Ce- (bifolio)
LFD hand: 4

Browse interlinear transliteration of f71r

Tentative identifications

This page as a whole represents the zodiac sign of Aries.

Other information

This is one of two illustrations of Aries, both containing 15 items. Without a doubt, each case represents half of the sign. This is done only for Aries and Taurus. The reason for this remains unknown.

General description

This is a zodiac page. For general information about zodiac pages see here.
There is extraneous writing near the central zodiac emblem.

Illustration(s)

A large circular diagram with the emblem of Gemini consisting of two clothed figures, one female on the right and one male on the left. They are holding each other's hands. The man wears green clothes and the woman a blue gown with very wide sleeves.

There are two circular arrangements of small, standing human figures (nymphs), and another five drawn at the top. There are 30 in total and with one exception (outer ring, lower right) they are all holding a star.

Text

This page has 32 text items (loci), as follows:
3 items of circular writing;
29 zodiac labels.

The month name June is written in the centre in a different hand than the remainder of the MS, and in a version of French (for which see here).

Currier language: -
RZ language: A (page) / Ce- (folio) / Ce- (bifolio)
LFD hand: 4

Browse interlinear transliteration of f72r2

Tentative identifications

This page as a whole represents the zodiac sign of Gemini.

Other information

Of the usual 30 combinations of nymph, star and label, there are two exceptions: in one case (outer ring, bottom right) the star is missing. In another case (outer ring, left) only the label is missing. It is not clear if this is intentional or a simple mistake.

General description

This is a zodiac page. For general information about zodiac pages see here.
There is extraneous writing near the central zodiac emblem.

Illustration(s)

A large circular diagram with the emblem of Cancer, unusually consisting of two obsters with a line connecting their mouths. The top one facing right is painted light green and the bottom one facing left is brick-red.

There are three circular arrangements of tubs with small, standing human figures (nymphs). There are 30 in total and they are all holding a star.

One of the nymphs wears a conspicuous crown. This is one of three cases in the zodiac (Cancer, Leo and Libra).

Text

This page has 34 text items (loci), as follows:
4 items of circular writing;
30 zodiac labels.

Three of the circular texts are longer, the fourth short one is around the zodiac emblem. There are 30 labels near the small human figures.

The month name July is written in the centre in a different hand than the remainder of the MS, and in a version of French (for which see here).

Currier language: -
RZ language: Ce- (page) / Ce- (folio) / Ce- (bifolio)
LFD hand: 4

Browse interlinear transliteration of f72r3

Tentative identifications

This page as a whole represents the zodiac sign of Cancer.

Other information

The lobster drawings have an unusual mistake: the four pairs of hind legs are attached to the wrong part of the body. This is something that can also be observed in a few other 15th century manuscripts.

Illustration(s)

A large circular diagram with the emblem of Virgo consisting a clothed female waering a blue gown with very wide sleeves and a blue headpiece. She holds a star 'on a stick' in her left hand, and there is a small flower on the ground in front of her.

There are two circular arrangements of small human figures (nymphs). There are 30 in total and they are all holding a star.

Tentative identifications

This page as a whole represents the zodiac sign of Virgo.

The dress of Virgo (and of Sagittarius) has been identified by Morgan library curator Roger Wieck as belonging to the time frame 1420-1430.
